newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU set to clear BA takeover of Air Liberte.
newsitem.headline: EU set to clear BA takeover of Air Liberte.

text.p: The European Commission is set to clear British Airways Plc's takeover of insolvent French airline Air Liberte, a spokesman for European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said on Wednesday.

Van Miert told a meeting of the European Parliament's transport committee on Tuesday that BA's chairman Robert Ayling had come to Brussels recently "to thank (the Commission) for its intervention in the Air Liberte case".
The French government had tried to pull out a few tricks, he added, but did not elaborate.
Van Miert's spokesman told Reuters the comments meant the acquisition would be cleared.
Van Miert was briefing the parliament on a separate controversial alliance between British Airways and AMR's American Airlines. A decision on this deal is not expected for another month.
BA submitted its proposed takeover of Air Liberte to the Commission for clearance under the EU's merger rules on January 29. The Commission has until next week to take a decision.
Air Liberte went into receivership in September and BA, which already owns French carrier TAT, put in a bid for it.

Industry and legal sources said the French government tried to counter the bid by having ailing regional airline AOM, which is owned by French state-controlled bank Credit Lyonnais, put in a rival proposal. But AOM never formally proposed buying Air Liberte.

The sources said the French government backtracked after the Commission intervened, saying it would not look kindly on the acquisition by AOM, because of its relationship with Lyonnais which has been receiving huge subsidies since 1994.
AOM is part of a vast group of loss-making assets hived off from Lyonnais in 1996 to help it survive. The divested assets are expected to be sold off.
"It was argued with the Commission that AOM should not buy any companies," a source said, adding that this would be tantamount to allowing subsidies given to Lyonnais to be used to make the purchase.
